summary.answer: With a cursor, computes bounds centered on the target. Animated path plays Release, begins50ms movement, updates bounds, and registers its focus/selection helper on transition completion; direct path updates bounds and calls it now. That helper chooses Snap/Acquire, sends gain_focus, stores selectedRegion and sends SpawnRegionFocus only for the written lobby mode or simulatedCT. Requests target lose_focus then DefaultClip, clears selectedRegion and hides cursor only when the keep-visible argument is falsy. Gets the stick vector, negates y in that same table and stores it on the receiver. Collects beacons whose native hit-test contains the cursor, computes squared center distance, sorts by ascending distance with its owned comparator, and returns first marker or nil. Equal-distance tie order is unspecified. Missing SpawnSelectionMap returns. Found target optionally deselects old region, selects new region and plays uin_main_edit. No target leaves selection unchanged. Returns whether native objective name equals spawnbeacon_objective. Non-sentinel objective ID compares native gamemode flags to f0_local1, otherwise false. Sentinel/flag upvalue values are outside this selected body and remain context gaps. Non-sentinel objective ID compares native gamemode flags to f0_local2, otherwise false. Exact upvalue values remain outside this body scope. For each beacon subscription, reads active/team/beacon/group predicates. Eligible missing beacon requests add; existing eligible beacon requests remove then add and a recovered goto. A remove follows the outer eligible block literally; do not invent a missing label/continue. PC keyboard-prompt branch preserves empty arms and local-looking assignments. Control-flow fidelity remains unresolved. Returns receiver.killcamFullscreen unchanged, with no boolean normalization. Returns whether killcamAnimTimer differs from nil. Truthy timer is closed before its receiver field becomes nil. No implicit guarantee of close success or idempotence beyond the written guard. Replaces beacons/subscription tables; existing AutoSpawnMarker is closed/selection cleared when hideautospawnoption==1, else made focusable and stored under sentinel; objId is written either way. AnimateMarkerPulse is called even with nil local marker. Installs newObjective subscription only if absent. Its delivered callback ignores active killcam and handles owned spawn-beacon/group models; death-marker/other arms are empty in recovered text. No old beacon table disposal occurs before replacement. Iterates beaconSubs and requests RemoveSpawnBeacon for each key. It does not directly close/remove newObjSubscription in this body. Starts with AutoSpawnMarker and replaces candidate for every non--1 pairs entry, so last traversal entry wins. Changed candidate deselects old, then selects/snaps a present candidate. An unchanged auto marker is selected again. No deterministic ordering is invented. Reads parent size and child rectangle, writes normalized X/Y and width(+20)/parent-width scale to shared KillcamPip fields. No division-by-zero guard or height scale. Installs spawnSelectEndTime model callback. A nonnil time records end/wait values and creates one50ms timer if absent. Its tick updates Clock/ClockGlow shader fractions from remaining/wait time and closes/nils the timer at remaining<=0. No initial immediate tick, nil-time cancellation, wait-zero guard or widget-close hook is supplied. Defaults false, sets true for sentinel objId, and also true for a present model whose state is active. It does not clear sentinel true for an inactive model.
